known_limitations.description: A blocking synchronous CPU provider returned after 2 seconds; all four query brackets were preserved and the acquisition rejected with zero retries. The gate enforces the acceptance deadline but does not hard-interrupt native calls.

Container preparation is not itself continuously sampled. A 3 second preparation gap fails closed before inference and cleans up the owned resource. A production run with long preparation needs root review, not a cadence reset.

Root must create a new 160-run plan and migrate the private pilot to the coordinator with fixed phase_started_utc matching real load/unload observed_at. Existing pilots and historical hashes are not relabeled.
